name: official 3d world workflow announcement

source.evidence_text: Lab introduces WorldFlow, an agentic workflow that generates large scale 3D open worlds from text prompts. Every scene is freely explorable and built entirely from editable, game-ready 3D assets.

brief: WorldFlow 是根据文本提示生成大型 3D 开放世界的智能体工作流，并使用可编辑、可用于游戏的 3D 资产构建场景。
